integers.name: LICENSE_ASSISTANT_TURN_MAX_LENGTH
integers.description: A turn of the history sent back: the assistant's replies and the summary are longer than a message. Fithara rejects a longer one.

integers.name: LICENSE_ASSISTANT_MAX_TURNS
integers.description: Fithara rejects a history with more turns. It condenses its own before it gets there, so only a client that edits the history can hit this.
